name: computer-use
description: Local desktop automation for macOS, Linux, and Windows through the pinned Open Computer Use fork.
author: Leo

skills.name: open-computer-use
skills.description: Inspect and operate desktop applications with the local Open Computer Use MCP server.

mcpServers.name: Open Computer Use
mcpServers.description: Pinned local desktop automation server. macOS access requires user-granted Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions.

args: const{spawn}=require('node:child_process');const entry=process.env.ELLM_SHA_OPEN_COMPUTER_USE_ENTRY;if(!entry){console.error('Open Computer Use runtime is missing. Rebuild eLLMsha from its pinned fork checkout.');process.exit(1)}const child=spawn(entry,['mcp'],{stdio:'inherit',windowsHide:true});child.on('error',error=>{console.error(error.message);process.exit(1)});child.on('exit',code=>process.exit(code??1));for(const signal of ['SIGINT','SIGTERM'])process.on(signal,()=>{if(!child.killed)child.kill(signal)})
